blocks.text: The global K-pop spotlight turns to Osaka this weekend. The MAMA Awards 2026 kicks off its two-day celebration on November 20 and 21 at the Kyocera Dome. Consequently, legendary icons, chart-topping groups, and rising rookie acts will gather under one roof. Presented by CJ ENM and broadcast via Mnet, the annual ceremony honors the past year’s biggest musical achievements. Specifically, fans can expect high-energy performances, special collaborations, and major award presentations. Meanwhile, actor Park Bo-gum returns as host and the event’s first-ever official MAMA Ambassador.
